digest.component_or_area: tests/interfaces rebar_repo fixture and isolation guards
propositions: Function-scoped rebar_repo fixture reruns git init and init_repo per test, making fixture setup ~47% of the tests/interfaces tier wall-clock and dominating the macOS Verified gate critical path.
Replacing per-test init with a session-scoped initialized template plus a shutil.copytree copy per test reduces setup from 306ms to 22.3ms per test.

Copied stores must rewrite the linked-worktree pointers in .tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees gitdir against the realpath template path, because a bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves the copy sharing the template's object store and refs.
The gate snapshot store keyed by commit SHA alone causes all copies of one template to collide on a single entry, so each test must set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR to a per-test directory.

The .env-id and .signing-key uuid4 values carried by copytree must be re-randomized via unconditional writes, since init._gen_local_files() guards writes and would silently skip re-randomization on an existing copy.

A tier-wide autouse guard must reject any store whose git worktree list --porcelain paths resolve outside its own REBAR_ROOT, and rev-parse --git-common-dir cannot be used because it is green-while-broken on a stale gitdir.
